title: 781. Transform to Chessboard

examples.explanation: One row swap plus one column swap reaches an alternating board.
The first column cannot be made alternating.

hints: Every row must equal the first row or its exact opposite; the same holds for columns, otherwise return -1.
Count ones in the first row and column: each must be n/2 or (n+1)/2.
Mismatches against the two alternating edge patterns divided by two give row and column swaps; for odd n pick the pattern with an even mismatch count.
